use_case: Transformer health scoring and rebuild demand forecasting (predictive maintenance): the oil laboratory's portal scores customer transformers from DGA results; the shop uses the scores to recommend repair, replacement, or continued service to customers and to forecast storm-season rebuild demand
vendor_or_model: Oil laboratory analytics vendor (machine learning health index model, vendor SaaS)
data_categories: DGA results; transformer nameplate data; customer asset IDs and, until removed, site coordinates (customer confidential, including the G&T cooperative's substation data); no personal data
affects_individuals: No (affects customers' grid equipment, not individuals)
human_in_the_loop: The Field Service and Test Technician reviews raw gas values and trends against the shop's written interpretation steps before any recommendation; the Shop Manager co-signs any keep-in-service recommendation for a unit the model rates poor; the score is never the only basis; customers make the final decision
applicable_laws: Customer confidentiality terms (cooperative master service agreement); cooperative exhibit sec. 1 if a vendor incident exposes cooperative data; FTC Act Sec. 5 for the shop's own claims about the service; no sector AI rule found
status: Pilot (3 customers, about 900 units); approved with conditions 2026-08-31; uploads paused until the conditions are met (target 2026-09-30)
